page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highmem-64 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512 GB of RAM. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, this instance allocates a consistent 8.0 GB of memory per virtual core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance without resource contention from neighboring tenants. With a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, the instance is structured to support memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe drives or hardware acceleration. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the n4d-highmem-64 offers a dense memory configuration relative to its compute footprint, making it a viable option for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of higher-tier compute or GPU resources.

This server configuration is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines. It is also appropriate for running medium-sized virtualization environments or backend applications that demand substantial memory capacity but do not rely on local disk I/O performance.
